name: OneDrive
author: crmartinez
description: Microsoft OneDrive personal client for the Omarchy bar.

schema.label: Download folder
schema.description: Where files are saved when you click one to download. Leave empty to use ~/Downloads.

schema.label: Upload start folder
schema.description: Local folder the upload file browser opens to. Leave empty to start at your home folder.

schema.label: Bar position
schema.description: Which section of the bar this widget appears in.

schema.label: Tracked folder
schema.description: Local folder to watch. New or changed files are uploaded automatically to a matching folder at the root of your OneDrive.

schema.label: Enable folder tracking
schema.description: Turn automatic upload on or off for the tracked folder.
